plan.subject: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its real-world applications.
plan.objective: Understand the foundational concepts of machine learning and its real-world applications.

blocks.title: Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Machine learning relies on mathematical concepts like probability theory, linear algebra, and calculus to model and analyze data.

blocks.title: What is Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the definition and scope of machine learning is essential for grasping its applications and limitations.
examples: Definition of machine learning as a field
Distinction between supervised and unsupervised learning

blocks.title: Real-World Applications of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: Seeing how machine learning is applied in real-life scenarios helps students appreciate its practical relevance.

blocks.title: Why Machine Learning?
blocks.teachingObjective: Understanding the motivations behind using machine learning helps students grasp its importance in modern technology.

blocks.title: Big Picture of Machine Learning
blocks.teachingObjective: The big picture of machine learning provides a conceptual framework for understanding its different types and uses.
examples: Taking picking fruits as an example
Classification and regression as core tasks

blocks.title: Examples of Machine Learning Tasks
blocks.teachingObjective: Concrete examples help students understand how machine learning is applied in different domains.
